title: Ngọn nến cuối
about: Round x9, for sleep with improvised melodies (style ngu-ngon), as the user asked ("tôi muốn những bài âm thanh u tối nhưng dễ nghe để ngủ hơn, có thể thêm những giai điệu ngẫu hứng"): the last candle in a dark room: low strings and the pad, very soft and warm (the organ pieces were only 'maybe'), the felt piano improvising quietly over it, a deep sub. C minor. Softer harmony than before (added ninths, major sevenths, no Phrygian rub), nothing sudden. An original piece; its melody made up by the improviser in dark/ambient.py.
